data.gender_notes: Gonçalo is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Galician name Goñez Kollo, which means 'born of royal lineage'. The name Gonçalo gained popularity among the Portuguese due to Saint Gonçalo, a companion of Saint Francis of Assisi. The name Gonçalo carries the meaning “Born of royal lineage” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gonçalo usually hope their child will grow to embody born of royal lineage and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: גונסאלו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: גונסאלו הוא שם פורטוגלי שמקורו בשם גונזלו, שמתבסס על המילים הגאליות 'gund' ו-'salvus', שפירושם 'מלחמה' ו'בריא, שלם', בהתאמה. השם קשור לאומץ ולשמירה על שלמות הנפש. במסגרת השמות הנוצרים, גונסאלו מתקשר לאומץ הלב ולקורבן עצמי למען האל.

in_greek.name: Γκονσάλο
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι ο Κύριος των θυσιών
in_greek.long_meaning: Το Γκονσάλο είναι παραλλαγή του ονόματος Γκονζάλο, το οποίο προέρχεται από τις γαλατικές λέξεις 'gund' και 'salvus', που σημαίνουν 'μάχη' και 'υγιής, ακέραιος', αντίστοιχα. Το όνομα συνδέεται με την ανδρεία και τη διατήρηση της πνευματικής ακεραιότητας. Στην παράδοση των Χριστιανικών ονομάτων, ο Γκονσάλο συμβολίζει την καρτερική στάση και την αυτοθυσία για τον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Gonçalo
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Gonçalo derivatur ex hispanico-galliaco nomine Gonzalo, quod componitur ex vocibus 'gund' et 'salvus', quae significant 'proelium' et 'sanus, integer', respective. Nomen hoc cum fortitudine et conservatione integritatis animae coniungitur. In traditione nominum christianorum, Gonçalo significat animi robur et sacrificium propter Deum.

in_english.name: Gonçalo
in_english.meaning: God is the lord of sacrifices
in_english.long_meaning: The name Gonçalo originates from the Hispanic-Gallician name Gonzalo, derived from the words 'gund' and 'salvus', meaning 'battle' and 'healthy, whole', respectively. It is associated with courage and the preservation of spiritual wholeness. In Christian tradition, Gonçalo symbolizes bravery and self-sacrifice for God. Historically, the name reflects the values of strength and devotion.

data.cultural_impact: The name Gonçalo has a rich cultural heritage in the Portuguese speaking world, especially in Portugal and Brazil. Historically, the name was associated with the noble class and royalty due to its origins as meaning 'born of royal lineage'. Today, it remains a common name among Portuguese and Brazilians, reflecting their proud cultural heritage.
data.spiritual_significance: In Catholicism, Gonçalo is most famously associated with Saint Gonçalo, also known as Gonçalo todis Milagros or "Gonçalo of the many miracles". Thus, the name Gonçalo carries a significant spiritual meaning, symbolizing faith, devotion, and a connection to the spiritual realm.
